about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions (gpt-5.6-terra, the deployment default) to the exact prompts the scenario in server/tests/support/reviewer-guidance.ts sends through the real app, store and gate: server/src/approvals/policy.ts (reviewPrompt, no response_format schema, as the live reviewer asks) and server/src/approvals/reviewer-guidance.ts (readingPrompt, with response_format json_schema). Each answer is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it, keyed by the SHA-256 of the prompt it answered, recorded 2026-11-10. A prompt that changes finds no answer here, and has to be recorded again.
